summary: Black Drift duel: Abby answers a rival captain without a speech.
settingText: BLACK DRIFT HAVEN — OPEN SALVAGE GANTRY — NIGHT

dialogueInline.speaker: Rival Captain
dialogueInline.text: Queens belong in the Core.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: Eat. Weld. Follow.

directionInline: A tumbling city of welded wrecks surrounds an asteroid. Forgefires spit into vacuum; oil-slick plating flashes bruised gold and violet. The rival sneers, Abby disarms him in one ugly-efficient movement and kicks him into a netted salvage pit. Hold on Abby as the watching crews erupt and engines spool up around the rock like answering throats.

summary: Abby's war deck: survival doctrine collides with Billie's appetite for spectacle.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: We bleed their shields at the feeders. We do not torch farms. Flow keeps us breathing.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: You can count flow after we take the cargo.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: Or we live first.

directionInline: Captains crowd a crude map table made from engine cowling. Billie lounges feral; Tess stays at the edge, watching everyone. Abby moves markers toward Auric Gate. Let the three women occupy the frame differently: Abby controlling space, Billie enjoying friction, Tess measuring the cost.

summary: The Silent Triarch reduces a war to three brutal verbs.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raid Mask
dialogueInline.text: Strike to feed.

dialogueInline.speaker: Trade Mask
dialogueInline.text: Flow sustains.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fear Mask
dialogueInline.text: Terror binds.

directionInline: Three masked emissaries sit motionless in mismatched salvage thrones: Raid, Trade, Fear. Each speaks only once. Abby's jaw tightens; she accepts the words without bowing. The silence after them should feel like another vote.

summary: At Auric Bazaar, policy sounds different when spoken beside people who need heat.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: We need more than food. Medicine. Fuel cells. Heat. Lights for the out-rings.

dialogueInline.speaker: Wallace
dialogueInline.text: And fewer tariffs dressed as blessings.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: You want safety? Ride formation and stop buying maps from raiders.

directionInline: Busy market life never stops around the argument: patched awnings, steaming food, cargo carts, mechanics carrying heater cores. Halev counts needs on his fingers. Wallace chews a grain stem. Naomi is all clipped military impatience.

summary: Halev chooses the green corridor because every alternative is worse.

dialogueInline.speaker: Wallace
dialogueInline.text: Maps that work are cheaper than escorts that don't.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Enough. Essential cargo only. Fleet on the wing—if they'll take the terms.

directionInline: A cold parent and child wait beside a failed heater module while a clinic queue moves under weak worklights. Halev notices them, and that concrete need ends the debate. He points toward the docks: decision made.

summary: The Admiralty argues whether a humanitarian lane is mercy or an exposed throat.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dominion
dialogueInline.text: Blockades hold. Green corridors invite knives.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Green lanes keep clinics stocked and heaters lit.

dialogueInline.speaker: Rhyne
dialogueInline.text: Civilians don't see a shield. They see the ships blocking the road.

directionInline: Formal council glow, polished stone and projected corridor maps. Dominion remains physically above Venn on the dais. Keating watches for weakness; Rhyne watches the civilian numbers. Venn never raises her voice, which makes the disagreement sharper.

summary: Dominion permits the experiment without conceding the principle.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dominion
dialogueInline.text: Hold the wall. Test their lane—under watch.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Understood.

directionInline: Dominion's gaze lands on Venn. She gives one economical nod: not victory, not defeat. As she turns away, the green route remains glowing between them on the table.

summary: The Shards swear their war-moot with engines instead of words.
settingText: BLACK DRIFT HAVEN — EXTERIOR SALVAGE DECK — NIGHT

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: The Core speaks in scrolls. The Verge in ledgers. The Shards—we swear with our engines.

directionInline: Dozens of ships ring the asteroid. One by one their engines flare in different colors and exhaust signatures until the whole haven becomes a brutal luminous chorus. Abby watches without smiling. Tess's voice is quiet over the spectacle.

summary: The feint begins: Billie treats Abby's restraint as an insult and enters wanting destruction rather than leverage.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: Fat ships coming. Light a tooth for luck.

directionInline: A skeletal truss slices through the Rift. Fast Shard skiffs form up with exact spacing while the Ashfang Marauder hangs just outside formation like an animal refusing a leash. Billie grins into open comms. The ordered skiffs and Ashfang's bad alignment must make the conflict visible before she speaks.

summary: Venn refuses the bait and chooses civilian protection while her officers expect retaliation.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: Confed pings entering feeder spine. Small, surgical.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Hold formation. Civilians first. No hero chases.

directionInline: Vectors bloom across Venn's holo. Junior officers look toward the attack solutions. Venn drags Thunderbreak's projected path between the raiders and the clinic ships, then turns the attack geometry into a moving shield. Show the crew's surprise, recalculation, and growing understanding around her choice.

summary: Tessa quietly saves lives while everyone else is looking for a fight.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: You're covered. Don't light your beacons.

directionInline: Tessa cold-drifts with engines dark. Outside, a medpod freighter spins toward exposed fire. She launches micro-tethers, catches it, and reels it beneath the shadow of heavy debris. Her crew exchanges looks. The page must show that she is still participating in the raid while secretly changing its human cost.

summary: Billie breaks the plan because destruction is the point for her.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: Now they'll remember us.

directionInline: Ashfang suddenly flares and strafes a storage spine. Thermal blankets and heater cells tumble into vacuum and ignite in bright, ugly sheets. Keep unlit civilian habitat rings or clinic craft visible beyond the fire. The horror is specifically wasted warmth: supplies burning where cold civilians can see them.

summary: Thunderbreak physically blocks Billie's firing lane instead of escalating the battle.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tactical
dialogueInline.text: Marauder off the leash.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Interpose. Do not escalate.

directionInline: Thunderbreak drives a drifting structural beam sideways and turns it into cover. Its armored flank fills the firing lane between Ashfang and the clinic freighter. Sparks cascade across the hull like a meteor shower. Venn watches Billie's vector without blinking. The action must read as deliberate protection, not an accidental collision or attack on civilians.

summary: Naomi turns a frightened escort line into something that can hold.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: On me! We're walking those clinic pods home.

directionInline: Naomi grips the controls hard enough to whiten her knuckles. Her escorts wobble into position, then settle into a clean protective line around the medpods. Keep her fear visible in her hands, eyes, and breathing. Competence does not erase it.

summary: Billie and Tessa leave the same raid with opposite lessons.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: Next pass we don't miss.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: Next pass you hit your own shadow.

directionInline: Abby's skiffs disengage exactly on the mark. Ashfang turns slowly, predatory and furious. Gravefire slips past on a quieter vector with the rescued freighter hidden in debris shadow. Tessa's line lands without heat. Billie has no answer.

summary: Jex sells Halev what institutions cannot quite provide: a compromise that can function now.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: You want a green lane? I can sell protection and silence. Both cost more than speeches.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: I want warmth in the outer rings and antiseptic in the clinics.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: Then you want me.

directionInline: Jex enters with anomaly-glass beads sewn into his cloak and a fresh bandage under one rib. Keep Jex, Naomi, and Halev in every speaking panel so each line receives two reactions. Naomi dislikes him immediately. Halev dislikes needing him more. The office should overlook dark habitat rings and visible clinic queues.

summary: Naomi and Jex establish their relationship while Halev accepts a temporary authority he does not trust.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Or the Fleet. Preferably the Fleet.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: Preferably profit. Preferably mine.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: No inspections. Rapid scans. You arbitrate disputes, for now.

directionInline: Jex smiles at 'for now' as if Halev offered a lifetime contract. Naomi gives him a look that promises the opposite. Halev signs anyway. Keep the new corridor terms, cargo categories, and arbitration markers legible on the physical slate so the compromise has visible machinery.

summary: The first corridor tests whether armed rivals can all choose not to fire.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: No one blinks. We do this and people sleep warm tonight.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Thunderbreak standing by. Weapons cold.

directionInline: Green navigation waypoints float through darkness. Freighters visibly carry heater cores, medpods, fuel cells, infant formula, and thermal blankets. Naomi leads inside the lane. Thunderbreak shadows outside it with weapons cold. Tessa ghosts at the edge. The tension is silence, held aim, and visible restraint rather than gunfire.

summary: Billie tests the corridor and discovers Abby can still stop her.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: Green means go.

directionInline: Confederation silhouettes drift in darkness, watching rather than striking. Ashfang creeps forward. A single hand command flashes from Abby's shadowed skiff. Billie stares at it, furious, then throttles down. Hold both Ashfang's forward pressure and Abby's small, absolute gesture in the same composition.

summary: Jex runs the corridor from a back room and prepares to survive either outcome.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: If anyone fires, you never heard of me. If no one fires, tell everyone it was me.

directionInline: Jex signs three slates at once while runners carry beacon codes, arbitration markers, and bribe lists. His bandaged rib hurts when he laughs. He laughs anyway. Make the physical traffic of orders and money more prominent than the room's atmosphere.

summary: The corridor's first anomaly appears and everyone has to resist shooting at a ghost.
settingText: GREEN CORRIDOR — MARKERS ONE AND TWO

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Mark one clear. Mark two... clear. Keep breathing.

directionInline: A reflection ripple runs beside the convoy. For one breath, a ghost freighter occupies the same lane as the real one, then fades. Fingers hover over triggers across opposing cockpits, but nobody fires. Naomi hears her own breathing in the headset. The real freighter and its duplicate must be visually distinguishable without making the anomaly look like an enemy attack.

summary: Venn registers a tiny victory in operational language while a junior officer sees what it cost her.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Log the crossing. Keep the lane open.

directionInline: The last green cargo icon clears the tactical boundary. The junior officer finally exhales, then catches Venn pressing two fingers briefly against the edge of the console to steady herself. Her shoulders release by a fraction. She immediately straightens and turns the safe crossing into the next maintenance task. No celebration, symbolic lights, or sentimental speech. The human beat is that Venn cannot openly claim relief, but the junior officer recognizes it.

summary: Halev sees cargo icons as the concrete lives they will change.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Heaters. Antibiotics. Battery cells. Good. Keep unloading.

directionInline: A cracked monitor reflects Halev's exhausted face while green cargo icons cross the last marker. Below him, dark apartment rings wait for power. A clinic queue is visible in a narrow strip of light. He closes his eyes only after the final icon clears.

summary: Abby admits why she let the convoy pass; Tessa offers a different future without demanding an answer.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: You let it pass.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: We need those clinics stocked when the next raid hits.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: Then stop making more work for them.

directionInline: Abby stands alone before the distant green pips and never turns toward Tessa. Tessa does not press her. Engines thrum through the deck like held breath. Keep repair scars, clinic inventories, and Abby's casualty board near the green route display so restraint reads as survival arithmetic, not sudden idealism.

summary: Naomi and Venn acknowledge each other's contribution with restrained professional warmth.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Verge convoy to Thunderbreak. Thanks for the shadow.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: You brought them through, Captain.

directionInline: The freighters peel toward Auric docks as the escorts finally loosen formation. Naomi smiles despite herself. On Thunderbreak, Venn listens to the confirmation, allows one small breath of relief, and gives Naomi the credit before returning to work. The warmth comes from recognition between two frightened, competent people.

summary: Billie's restraint holds only because Abby has temporarily imposed it; her threat becomes personal and tactical.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: Next time, I choose the mark.

directionInline: Ashfang's engines flare hard enough to light nearby hulls. Billie holds the burn for one dangerous second while her targeting reticle settles on the departing convoy. Abby's hand command remains visible as a small reflection on Billie's canopy. Billie powers down with visible effort and never looks away from the target. Restraint must look physically harder for her than violence.

summary: Jex recognizes that a temporary compromise has made him structurally necessary and intends to own that dependency.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: Now they need the road. Tomorrow they need me.

directionInline: Jex raises a glass to nobody while new corridor orders arrive before the previous batch finishes printing. He looks from the route map to the growing queue of petitioners outside his office. His bandaged rib catches when he laughs. The last image is not a generic toast. It is Jex recognizing the shape of power he has just created.
